summary: The repeat of the simultaneous-restart experiment (receipt c1dcda29549b48c7a775adfc2e9a4bda) reproduced the outcome exactly: with RestoreCommittedLogs all three voters return with empty configurations and no leader appears in the observation window (violated, witness 1), while the control keeps [3,3,3] and elects a leader (holds, index 3) — and the staged commit indices differed from the first run ([11 10 11] versus [11 11 9]), so this is reproducibility under schedule variation rather than a fixed schedule. The parent interpretation now cites that receipt, records it as counterevidence against a single-run timing explanation, and states that the headline progress claim rests on two scored executions; the consolidated applicability summary from last turn remains the current account of the question.
